title: pontechium maculatum
intro: Pontechium maculatum, commonly known as Ptelea maculata, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is a deciduous shrub native to eastern Asia and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pontechium maculatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
